description: Ten D047 landscape candidates paired with the mapped numbered source photos for unapproved artwork comparison.
review_notice: This Dasakam 47 chapter is presented for artwork review only. Ten selected landscape candidates are unapproved and have independent exact-checksum visual passes bound to the final plan (reports G/H/I). Producer inspections, measured candidate details, and the authorized S006 v018 skin deviation are recorded with provenance. Photos 001–008 map in order; photo 005 shows monkeys although its English caption says cat, so the canonical stanza governs. Photo 009 shows Yashoda present, unlike the caption and canonical stanza; photo 010 is a title poster, not a stanza scene. Photos 011–012 are Tamil text pages and remain unmapped. No vetted English translation is supplied; editorial review remains pending. Portrait production remains paused. Art is not approved.

rows.scene: Krishna climbs into Yashoda’s lap while she churns curd.
rows.candidate_status: Producer inspection: Krishna forehead plain with one low gold band and upright feather; Krishna face B-R 53 and torso 105. Yashoda 31x31 skin-patch medians: face R-B 116 (approx x730,y260), upper hand 114, upper arm 119, lower hand 121; the lower hand remains marginally above the approximate 120 target. Krishna visible open hand shows thumb plus four fingers; both visible feet show five toes. No duplicate figure, detached limb, or readable text. Independent exact-checksum review passed (report H); not art approval.
rows.notes: Producer review: art/reviews/d047-s001-landscape-v006-producer-v003.md. Independent exact-checksum review passed (report H); not art approval.

rows.scene: Yashoda leaves the feeding Krishna to tend milk overflowing on the fire.
rows.candidate_status: Yashoda cheek and forearm skin-only 31x31 medians R-B 131 and 130 (about 10–11 above the approximate 120 guide); her skin reads warm medium-brown at native size. Krishna remains deep indigo-blue (B-R 99/98 on face/arm). Yashoda reaching/support hands and Krishna open hand each show a thumb plus four fingers; visible toes count five. Yashoda turns from lap-feeding Krishna toward overflowing milk at the lit hearth. Bare forehead; no duplicate, malformed limb, text, signature, watermark, rays or beams. Independent exact-checksum review passed (report H); not art approval.

rows.scene: After Yashoda leaves, Krishna eats butter hidden in the mortar hole.
rows.candidate_status: Canonical scene: Yashoda has left, and Krishna alone eats the butter hidden in the mortar cavity; photo 009 instead shows Yashoda present. In selected v003, both fully visible feet show five distinct toes; the face/torso B-R medians are 133/90, with plain forehead, low band and one feather. The butter hand and mortar-bracing hand are attached and show no visible deformity. Earlier v001 had four clear toes on the viewer-right foot; v002 remained unclear/fewer than five on its side-on foot. No second physical Krishna, malformed limb, text, or poster lettering observed. Artwork remains unapproved.

rows.scene: The devas praise Krishna, who is bound by Yashoda despite being beyond bonds.
rows.candidate_status: Three modestly crowned adult witnesses with joined prayer hands appear on a cloud-backed celestial balcony, praising the bound child Krishna; the title poster is not copied. Deva skin-only 31x31 medians R-B 95–97; Krishna face/torso B-R 131/129. Both visible feet show five toes. Krishna’s relaxed fingers at his sides are partly occluded by the waist cord; deva prayer digits overlap and are not individually countable at native size, with no visible digit defect. No duplicate, malformed limb, text, rays or beams. Independent exact-checksum review passed (report G); not art approval.
